mechanics.name: Windows of Opportunity
mechanics.currentEffect: Within 24 metres, you see the Auras of Windows. You vault Windows 10% faster. Whenever you vault a Window, the perk goes on cooldown for 40/35/30 seconds.
activation: A Window is within 24 metres for its Aura to be revealed.
Vault a Window to receive the 10% faster Window-vault effect while the perk is available.
Ends/deactivates when: After vaulting a Window, the perk is on cooldown for 40/35/30 seconds.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Complete rework: now reveals only Window Auras within 24 metres, grants 10% faster Window vaults, and enters a 40/35/30-second cooldown after vaulting a Window.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: See nearby Windows and vault them faster, with a tiered cooldown after each Window vault.
specialInteractions: The 10.2.0 rework removes Pallet and Breakable Wall Aura reading; only Windows are revealed.

editorial.summary: See nearby Window Auras and vault Windows 10% faster, with a cooldown after each Window vault.
useCases: Identify nearby Windows quickly in unfamiliar structures.
Turn close Window timings into safer escapes with 10% faster vaults.
Use the Aura layer to plan a Window-heavy chase route before committing.
counters: Vaulting a Window puts the entire perk on cooldown for 40/35/30 seconds.
It no longer reveals Pallets or Breakable Walls.
Twenty-four metres is much less map coverage than the old Tier III range.
pros: 10% faster Window vaulting is direct chase power.
Window Auras still help unfamiliar-map routing.
cons: Lost Pallet and Breakable Wall information in 10.2.
Cooldown means the Aura and speed package is not permanent.
Much less beginner macro coverage than the pre-10.2 version.
analysis: Windows of Opportunity changed identity in 10.2. It is no longer the always-on all-resource map overlay that justified an elite information ranking; it now specializes in Windows and directly accelerates vaults by 10%.

The faster vault is meaningful. Tight Window timings decide many hits, and a ten-percent modifier can turn a marginal connection into a clean escape. The nearby Window Auras also remain useful when a structure is unfamiliar or visually cluttered.
The cost is information breadth and uptime. Pallets and Breakable Walls disappeared from the perk, the Aura range is fixed at 24 metres, and every Window vault starts a 40/35/30-second cooldown.

That makes modern Windows more of a chase-tech perk than a universal teaching tool. It can still be strong, but the old top-ten logic based on permanent Pallet-and-Window knowledge no longer applies and must be re-audited.
editorial.verdict: Still a legitimate chase perk, but no longer the universal resource radar it used to be. The 10% vault bonus keeps it relevant while the cooldown and loss of Pallet information demand a lower fresh ranking.
